edits.location: H2 'What to prepare before you leave Australia', intro line (line 66)
edits.issue: Legal sequence is incomplete. It leaves out the Notary Public step that the next H3 says is required (fact_24), and does not say both the original and the translation carry apostilles (fact_08). This is a legal step with no marker.
edits.fix: Replace with: "At home, the order that works is certificate, then NAATI Italian translation, then a Notary Public's notarisation of the translation, then DFAT apostilles on the original and the translation. <!-- fact_08 --> <!-- fact_24 -->"

edits.location: H3 'Birth certificate and single status certificate', paragraph 1, first sentence (line 70)
edits.issue: Misattributed. Sydney says these documents go to the comune (fact_08), not to the consulate. 'Ask for' implies the consulate wants them.
edits.fix: Replace the first sentence with: "The consulates in Sydney and Adelaide say your comune will need your original birth certificate and a Single Status Certificate from your state's Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages, each with a NAATI Italian translation and a DFAT Apostille. <!-- fact_08 --> <!-- fact_14 -->" Leave the Queensland and NT sentence as it is.

edits.location: H3 'DFAT apostilles and NAATI translations', paragraph 1, last sentence (line 76): writer-flagged 'eight apostilles'
edits.issue: The arithmetic is right (2 people x 2 certificates + 2 translations = 8) but it has no marker, and it holds only for Sydney's list (fact_08). Keep it, but scope it and add the marker.
edits.fix: Replace with: "On Sydney's list, two Australians with two certificates and two translations each can need eight apostilles. <!-- fact_08 -->"

edits.location: H2 'Step by step once you arrive in Italy', paragraph 1 (line 86): writer-flagged 'allow a working week'
edits.issue: The advice is sound and comes from the insider_details. But 'Offices keep weekday-morning hours' generalises one office's hours (Rome Prefettura, fact_26) to every office. Ground the advice in the two sourced facts instead.
edits.fix: Replace with: "On the ground the order is Rome or Milan, then the Prefettura, then the comune. Rome's Prefettura legalisation office opens four mornings a week, and some comuni want your declaration three days before the wedding, so allow a working week rather than arriving two days out. <!-- fact_26 --> <!-- fact_30 -->"

edits.location: H3 'The ceremony and your interpreter', paragraph 1, second sentence (line 106)
edits.issue: Generalised. Only Bagno a Ripoli states that it does not provide the interpreter (fact_31). 'The comune' reads as a rule for all of Italy.
edits.fix: Replace with: "Bagno a Ripoli does not provide one; finding the interpreter is up to you. <!-- fact_31 -->"

edits.location: Timeline table, row 'As soon as you have a date' (line 120)
edits.issue: 'Hardest to book' overstates the Embassy's wording, which says appointments 'can be difficult' to get from May to September (fact_34).
edits.fix: Change "May to September is hardest to book." to "appointments are harder to get from May to September."

edits.location: Timeline table, row 'At least 15 days before (Bagno a Ripoli)' (line 124)
edits.issue: Tying the interpreter to the 15-day deadline is not sourced. Bagno a Ripoli's 15-day deadline is for the witness form and payment receipt (fact_32). The interpreter only has to be found 'in good time' (fact_31), and is needed by the declaration.
edits.fix: Replace the 'What to do' cell with: "Name your witnesses and send the payment receipt; have your interpreter booked by now. <!-- fact_31 --> <!-- fact_32 -->"

edits.issue: Overgeneralised. The change-of-name rule is sourced for NSW and Victoria only (fact_41, fact_42), and Smartraveller says to check with your own state registry (fact_38).
edits.fix: Replace the 'What to do' cell with: "Nothing to register. To change your surname in NSW or Victoria, apply for a change of name; elsewhere, check your state registry. <!-- fact_38 --> <!-- fact_41 --> <!-- fact_42 -->"

edits.location: H2 'Civil, Catholic or symbolic', paragraph 1 (line 137): writer-flagged 'symbolic ceremony not legal'
edits.issue: Accepted as written. The source pack (must_include_coverage) approves this as advice drawn from fact_02, fact_28 and fact_36. It only needs markers so the fact log traces it.
edits.fix: Append after the paragraph: "<!-- fact_02 --> <!-- fact_28 --> <!-- fact_36 -->"
